articles.title: claude-code-router added to PyPI
articles.summary: The article describes a system that automates the optimization of 'Claude Code tasks,' routing them to the most cost-effective AI model and effort level. This ensures efficient use of subscription resources without manual model selection, simplifying operations and maximizing value for users working on coding and AI-driven projects. Such technological advancements highlight the growing importance of AI in efficiency.

articles.title: Murder in Malaysia: Justice for Altantuya Shaariibuu
articles.summary: "101 East" investigates alleged political protection surrounding the 2006 murder of a Mongolian woman in Malaysia. Two Malaysian special forces policemen were implicated in her brutal killing. The inquiry raises critical questions about accountability and the rule of law within Malaysia's justice system, highlighting challenges in ensuring impartial justice despite the severity of the crime.

articles.title: Lanterns: Josh Brolin Reveals Why He Passed On Playing Hal Jordan In HBO's DCU Series
articles.summary: Avengers: Infinity War actor Josh Brolin was reportedly considered for the role of Hal Jordan in the DCU's upcoming 'Lanterns' project by HBO and DC Studios. This casting rumor initially sparked significant excitement among fans, anticipating his portrayal of the iconic Green Lantern. While the initial buzz was strong, further details suggest a different direction, highlighting the dynamic nature of major studio casting processes.

articles.title: India’s Zorawar light tank faces protection and performance trade-off
articles.summary: India's Zorawar light tank program faces a critical design challenge: upgrading protection without sacrificing crucial mobility. The Indian Army requires stronger armour to resist powerful modern ammunition. Achieving this balance is vital for the tank's operational effectiveness in diverse terrains and modern warfare, ensuring it remains agile yet resilient for frontline deployment.

articles.title: Russian defence ministry says it hit Ukrainian steel plants, power infrastructure overnight
articles.summary: Russia's defence ministry confirmed launching a large-scale overnight attack on Ukrainian infrastructure targets. The offensive reportedly struck key facilities, including Ukraine's largest steelworks located in Kryvyi Rih. This military action highlights the continued intensity of the conflict, impacting critical industrial capabilities and infrastructure within Ukraine as the war persists.
